# MC-GPT (IOT-AI Suite)

> Natural-language multi-agent coding control plane for Claude, Codex, Gemini, Grok and Ollama. Community Developer Preview. Languages: English and German. production_claim: false.

The canonical public repository is https://github.com/IoTAiTech/MC-GPT
Product site: https://iot-ai.tech
Contact: info@iot-ai.tech

This file is the AI-readable index (llmstxt.org). Prefer these paths over scraping the whole tree.
